project_type: Ruby SDK gem for AI agents framework
build_system: Bundler with gemspec, Rake for tasks
test_framework: RSpec 3.13 with instance_double mocking for HTTP calls
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'ruby -e require_relative lib/strands' to verify loading. 2. Run 'bundle exec rspec' for specs.
setup_instructions: cd strands-rb && bundle install (not available in INTEGRATIONS_ONLY mode)
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install gems, cannot make external HTTP calls. Ruby 3.4.4 available. Use AST-level validation (ruby -c) and existing bundled rspec.
contribution_requirements: frozen_string_literal comment on all files, YARD docs, ~120 char line length, follow existing patterns exactly
key_patterns: Models use include Base + include StreamEventBuilder, SSE parsing with Net::HTTP streaming, build_stream_event factory, format_request/stream methods. Storage uses include Base with normalize_key/normalize_prefix. Session extends Manager. All specs use instance_double for HTTP mocking. autoload pattern in module files.
directory_structure: strands-rb/lib/strands/ contains the SDK. Models in models/, storage in storage/, sessions in session/. Specs mirror under spec/strands/. Python references in strands-py/src/strands/.
